C-HASHED-BUNDLE-IDS-2.IntentSummary:
Author the execution for the approved, fingerprinted spec `.ngrace/changes/active/C-HASHED-BUNDLE-IDS-2/spec.xml` (ratified `approved` with the maintainer's phrase, `ngrace review` 0 findings, `ngrace gate approve` permit, commit `9b00367` on `c-hashed-bundle-ids`) and only within it; this `-2` is the lineage successor of `C-HASHED-BUNDLE-IDS`, superseded at `852b150` because a scope that could not hold its own rule was owed one more file; the plan conforms to the spec, it does not extend, narrow or reinterpret it. Ceremony tier **T2** per the spec's `Constraints`. This bundle implements `D38`: `ngrace spec new` mints `C-<SLUG>-<N>-<HASH>` from a bare slug, a handed-in timestamp and branch; `ngrace supersede` parses the predecessor's lineage and accepts or mints the exact successor; the permissive `ANCHOR_PATTERNS.change` stays byte-identical and the strict `ANCHOR_PATTERNS.mintedChange` stays out of `ANCHOR_FAMILIES`, so the 100 legacy bundles and both registry layers keep working; the skeleton seeds a docs-and-examples `NonGoal` (`F249`'s product half); `ngrace-spec`, `ngrace-plan`, the two spec teaching templates (the plan templates are byte-identical) and the README carry the form; and the record mints one live chartered row while `D38`'s two `CodifiedIn` children land at the close.
**This is a `src/` bundle with four production files, and it creates none.** Confirmed at this plan's commit: the four production files `src/artifact/types.ts`, `src/grace-generate.ts`, `src/grace-supersede.ts` and `src/artifact/skeletons.ts` all exist, and every named suite (`src/artifact/grammar.test.ts`, `src/grace-generate.test.ts`, `src/grace-supersede.test.ts`, `src/docs-claims.test.ts`, `scripts/check-teaching-surface.test.ts`, `scripts/generate-skeleton-templates.test.ts`, `scripts/validate-record-retirement.test.ts`, `src/test-support/token-accounting.test.ts`) all exist. So `change.graph-anchors-miss-write-scope` has no window: the only module-ownable paths in `ObservedWriteScope` are `src/artifact/types.ts` (owned by `M-ARTIFACT-TYPES`), `src/grace-generate.ts` and `src/grace-supersede.ts` (owned by `M-CLI`), and `src/artifact/skeletons.ts` (owned by `M-GRAMMAR`); the `.test.ts` files are not module-ownable, `scripts/` is lint-ignored (`.ngrace-lint.json` `ignoredDirs`), and the skills, templates, README and record files sit under no module `Path`. `DurableScope` is exactly the spec's five `AffectedAreas` anchors: `M-ARTIFACT-TYPES`, `M-CLI`, `M-GRAMMAR`, `M-SKILLS` and `M-TEST-SUPPORT`, each paired with its shipped `V-M-*`.
Six sequential tasks carry the committed sequence. **T-001** is the grammar and parser in `src/artifact/types.ts` (`ANCHOR_PATTERNS.mintedChange`, `parseBundleId`, `nextBundleLineage`) with the red-first tests in `src/artifact/grammar.test.ts`. **T-002** is the mint: `src/grace-generate.ts` (the slug-to-id mint, the refusal set, the `mint:`/`mint-search:` report), the docs-and-examples seed in `src/artifact/skeletons.ts`, the red-first tests in `src/grace-generate.test.ts`, and the two regenerated spec teaching templates (the plan templates are byte-identical). **T-003** is the lineage in `src/grace-supersede.ts` (parse the predecessor, accept only the exact successor, or mint it) with the red-first tests in `src/grace-supersede.test.ts` and the `src/gates/core.test.ts` `C-SUPERSEDE-COMMAND T-004` fixture pair moved to `C-OLD`/`C-OLD-2`. **T-004** is the teaching and the README: the section-scoped needles and README claims red-first, then the sentences in `ngrace-spec` and `ngrace-plan` plus their packaged mirrors, the README examples, and the re-measured skill footprint. **T-005** is the record: the red-first row and `D38` codification walks in `scripts/validate-record-retirement.test.ts`, the live `C-HASHED-BUNDLE-IDS-2` row in `registry.xml`, and the shipped `--rewrite-roots`. **T-006** is verification and the faithful post-close applied-archive drive over every `CloseEvidence` command.
**The close is the authority's act and this plan's tasks end before it.** Execution ends when T-006 is verified and its cursor events are recorded; no task performs `terminal`, `fold`, `review`, the verdict, `gate apply`, `gate archive`, `ngrace apply`, the close's `--retire`, the `CodifiedIn` hand write on the production record, any production `CloseEvidence` run, or the archive move. Which task leaves each close-needed piece in place: T-001 leaves the minted grammar parsing; T-002 leaves `spec new` minting and the bare-mint CI-red gone; T-003 leaves `supersede` deriving the lineage; T-004 leaves the sentences in both trees and the footprint re-measured; T-005 leaves the `C-HASHED-BUNDLE-IDS-2` row **live** in `registry.xml` (base re-derived by `--rewrite-roots`, no ceiling raised), `D38` **live** in `rulings.xml` with **no** `CodifiedIn` (the shipped `decision-eligible-still-live` would refuse it earlier), and the shipped validator exiting 0. The close then runs `lint --assertions final --run-commands`, `ngrace apply` (which writes `applied` and renames the bundle into `.ngrace/changes/archive/`), hand-writes `D38`'s two `<CodifiedIn kind="test-suite">` children into `rulings.xml` **after** `apply` and **before** `--retire`, then runs its own `--retire` (expected `moved 2` — `D38` and the row), then evaluates the `CloseEvidence`. No sentence in this plan implies execution performs any of those.
**The red-first pairs, one signature key each, driven task by task on the whole-repository copy `/tmp/ng-hbi/repo` (rsync of the working tree including `.git` and untracked files, with `node_modules` as a real directory) at this plan's commit; the counts are observed, not predicted.** (1) T-001 appends the minted-grammar tests to `src/artifact/grammar.test.ts` **before** any production edit and drives them: red, `0 pass / 1 fail / 1 error` (`SyntaxError: Export named 'nextBundleLineage' not found`); the `src/artifact/types.ts` additions are the pass, **97 pass / 0 fail** (93 shipped + 4 new). Signature-kind `test`, key `bundle-id-tests-first`. (2) T-002 appends the mint, refusal, seed and determinism tests to `src/grace-generate.test.ts` and flips the shipped `refuses a slug that would be valid only after prepending C-` test at `:73` **before** any production edit and drives them: red, **11 pass / 10 fail**; the `src/grace-generate.ts` mint plus the `src/artifact/skeletons.ts` seed plus the regenerated templates are the pass, **21 pass / 0 fail**, with `scripts/generate-skeleton-templates.test.ts` **5 pass / 0 fail**. Signature-kind `test`, key `spec-new-mint-tests-first`. (3) T-003 appends the lineage tests to `src/grace-supersede.test.ts` and moves `src/gates/core.test.ts`'s `C-SUPERSEDE-COMMAND T-004` fixture pair to `C-OLD`/`C-OLD-2` **before** any production edit and drives them against the base `src/grace-supersede.ts`: red, `src/grace-supersede.test.ts` **14 pass / 4 fail**, `src/gates/core.test.ts` **111 pass / 0 fail** (the fixture move alone is accepted by the base, so the four lineage refusals are the red); the strict `src/grace-supersede.ts` lineage rule is the pass, `src/grace-supersede.test.ts` **18 pass / 0 fail**, `src/gates/core.test.ts` **111 pass / 0 fail**. Signature-kind `test`, key `supersede-lineage-tests-first`. (4) T-004 adds the section-scoped needles and their suite mirror **before** any skill edit and drives `bun ./scripts/check-teaching-surface.ts check`: **exit 1**, `refusal: skills/ngrace/ngrace-spec/SKILL.md — taught rules (the rule is taught in <docs_and_examples>): missing token "replace this placeholder"`; the pinned sentences in both trees are the pass, **exit 0**. Signature-kind `test`, key `teaching-needles`. In the same task, and separately, it adds the README assertions to `src/docs-claims.test.ts` **before** the README edit and drives them: red, **3 pass / 2 fail**; the README examples are the pass, **5 pass / 0 fail**. Signature-kind `test`, key `readme-claims`. The pairs interleave fail A, pass A, fail B, pass B (F250: the attempt-pair audit pairs only the last fail per task). (5) T-005 appends the `C-HASHED-BUNDLE-IDS-2` carrier-and-row walk and the `D38` codification walk to `scripts/validate-record-retirement.test.ts` **before** any record write and drives them: red, **113 pass / 3 fail** (the row is absent); the live row plus `--rewrite-roots` is the pass, **116 pass / 0 fail**, with registry `12 / 14 / 26` → `13 / 13 / 26`. Signature-kind `test`, key `record-row-tests-first`. (6) T-006 records pass against signature-kind `test`, key `post-close-drive`.
**Why six tasks and not fewer.** The fix budgets bind per task (`src/grace-cursor.ts` `FIX_SIGNATURE_REPEAT_BUDGET = 2` and `FIX_DISTINCT_SIGNATURE_BUDGET = 4`). T-001 has one signature family (the grammar tests first, then the production edit). T-002 has one (the mint tests first, then production plus templates). T-003 has one. T-004 has two distinct (the teaching needles, the README claims) — inside the distinct budget of 4. T-005 has one. T-006 is verification and the post-close drive, not a write task. Four independent production files in one task would put four distinct failure families in one budget and force a supersede on the first wrong guess; six tasks keep each write family separable. The last task's `git diff --exit-code` over `src/` and `scripts/` excludes all thirteen files the bundle writes, so `AC-NO-PRODUCTION-DRIFT`'s pathset is exactly that task's exclusion set.
**Why the scope names the record files no task writes.** `ObservedWriteScope` declares the five record files the plan mints and the close writes — the `registry.xml` T-005 mints, and `rulings.xml` (the `CodifiedIn` hand write), `decisions.xml` (the index layer flip), `rulings-retired.xml` and `registry-retired.xml` (the close's `--retire`). The close's writes land while the plan is still under `active/` and the scope and WriteEvidence audits run at the close, so a path the close writes must already be declared; declaring it is permission, not obligation (`run-ledger.xml` is the shipped precedent). The bundle's own `spec.xml`, `plan.xml` and `design-context.xml` are **not** declared — the identity skip already covers them at plan-approve.
**The baseline needles assert only what the bundle leaves unchanged.** `ANCHOR_PATTERNS.change` stays byte-identical (`change: /^C-[A-Z0-9]+(?:-[A-Z0-9]+)*$/,` in `types.ts`); `ANCHOR_FAMILIES` stays untouched in `src/artifact/grammar.ts`; `checkDocsAndExamplesDecision` stays untouched; and every shipped suite is green at `264e502` (`src/artifact/grammar.test.ts` 93 pass / 0 fail, `src/grace-generate.test.ts` 19/0, `src/grace-supersede.test.ts` 13/0, `src/docs-claims.test.ts` 2/0, `scripts/check-teaching-surface.test.ts` 49/0, `scripts/generate-skeleton-templates.test.ts` 5/0, `scripts/validate-record-retirement.test.ts` 111/0, `src/test-support/token-accounting.test.ts` 9/0). The shipped test `refuses a slug that would be valid only after prepending C-` (`src/grace-generate.test.ts:73`) is **flipped by design** — a target `MustNotContain`, never a baseline needle. Every baseline `MustContain` / `MustPassCommand` was driven with `--assertions baseline --run-commands` on the approved-shaped copy `/tmp/ngrace-plan-probe2/repo` (plan approved via `gate approve --artifact plan`, epoch 1 open on `T-001`), and again on `/tmp/ng-hbi/repo`; both runs exit 0 with plain lint 0/0.
**The mapping, fixed by the spec's own Constraint.** Exactly one criterion — `AC-NO-CURRENT-MODE` — carries no `CloseEvidence` and is mapped by exactly one task `Satisfies`; it is carried by T-006, this plan's only `Satisfies`. The other eighteen criteria are close-bound and stay unmapped, because a `Satisfies` of a close-bound criterion is the shipped error `change.close-evidence-and-satisfied` and an unmapped non-CloseEvidence criterion is the warning `AC-CLOSE-LINT`'s `--fail-on warnings` turns into an uncloseable bundle. Every `CloseEvidence` is evaluated only in the applied-archive state, so T-006 writes its drive against the state the ceremony produces, never the pre-close tree.
**Determinism.** `validate:determinism` scores the review detectors over a defect corpus and runs a two-run identity check; the new verbs add **nothing** to that surface — `spec new` and `supersede` are not review detectors and the scorer never invokes them. The determinism the spec actually requires is internal to the mint (same branch and timestamp yield the same id), and it is proven by a unit assertion in `src/grace-generate.test.ts`, not by the CI ratchet. The plan proves the ratchet stays green by driving `bun run validate:determinism` at baseline and again inside the post-close copy in T-006; no corpus entry, baseline key or scorer number moves.
**The committed state machine** ends at: T-005's boundary registry `13 / 13 / 26` after the mint's `--rewrite-roots` (only `registry.xml` changed in the record), rulings unchanged `1733 / 150 / 1883`, findings `7522 / 311 / 7833` and index `269 / 27 / 296` untouched, and every shipped validator at zero. The authority's close: `ngrace apply` archives the bundle, the `CodifiedIn` hand write lands, and `--retire` reports `moved 2`; registry returns to `12 / 14 / 26`, `D38` sits in `rulings-retired.xml` carrying its two resolving `CodifiedIn` children, the row sits in `registry-retired.xml`, the `D38` index layer flips in place, and a second `--retire` reports `moved 0`. Every `CloseEvidence` command and `bun run validate:ci` exit 0 in the post-close copy (observed end to end on `/tmp/ng-hbi/repo`: `apply --force` archives the bundle, the `CodifiedIn` hand write reds `decision-eligible-still-live` before the move, `--retire` reports `moved 2`, a second reports `moved 0`, and `validate:ci` exits 0).

T-001.Title: Add the minted-grammar and lineage-parse tests red-first and land the strict pattern, parseBundleId and nextBundleLineage in src/artifact/types.ts

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: AC-HEAD-RED (bundle-id-tests-first): in its own tool round trip, before any production edit, append the minted-grammar cases to `src/artifact/grammar.test.ts` in the existing `describe` house shape: a `describe("C-HASHED-BUNDLE-IDS-2 minted id grammar")` asserting that `ANCHOR_PATTERNS.mintedChange` accepts `C-FOO-1-ABCDEF12` and `C-FOO-12-01234567` and rejects the legacy `C-FOO`, `C-FOO-2`, `C-FOO-1-ABCDEF1` (7 hex), `C-FOO-0-ABCDEF12` (lineage 0) and `C-FOO-1-abcdef12` (lowercase); that `parseBundleId` reads `C-FOO-1-ABCDEF12` as `{ slug: "C-FOO", lineage: 1, hash: "ABCDEF12", minted: true }`, `C-FOO-2` as `{ slug: "C-FOO", lineage: 2, minted: false }`, and `C-FOO` as `{ slug: "C-FOO", lineage: undefined, minted: false }`; and that `nextBundleLineage` returns 2 for `C-FOO`, 3 for `C-FOO-2`, and 2 for an unknown lineage. The shipped `ANCHOR_PATTERNS.change` is asserted **true** for `C-FOO`, `C-FOO-2` and `C-FOO-1-ABCDEF12` in the same block — the legacy edge is a property of the permissive pattern and belongs to `AC-LEGACY-ACCEPTED`. Driven before any production edit: the new `it`s red because the exports do not exist. Record the cursor attempt with outcome fail, signature-kind `test`, signature-key `bundle-id-tests-first`. Run only this file. Do not edit `src/artifact/types.ts` in this round trip. Failure conditions: the block reuses the shipped `ANCHOR_PATTERNS.change` acceptance without asserting the minted pattern's rejections; a rejection case is one the strict pattern is not meant to catch.

Production then pass: add `ANCHOR_PATTERNS.mintedChange` `/^C-[A-Z0-9]+(?:-[A-Z0-9]+)*-[1-9][0-9]*-[0-9A-F]{8}$/` to the `ANCHOR_PATTERNS` object literal in `src/artifact/types.ts` **without touching the `change` entry or its byte bytes**, add the exported `parseBundleId` returning `{ slug: string; lineage?: number; hash?: string; minted: boolean }` (a minted id strips the trailing `-<HASH>` then `-<N>`; a legacy id with a trailing all-digits segment yields that lineage; any other legacy id yields `lineage: undefined`), and the exported `nextBundleLineage` returning `(lineage ?? 1) + 1`. Do **not** add the minted pattern to `ANCHOR_FAMILIES` (which lives in `src/artifact/grammar.ts:247`) and do not edit `src/artifact/grammar.ts` at all. Then `bun test --timeout=30000 src/artifact/grammar.test.ts` exits 0 with the shipped 93 tests untouched and the new minted-grammar block green. Record the cursor attempt with outcome pass for signature-key `bundle-id-tests-first`. Failure conditions: the `change` entry modified; the minted pattern registered in `ANCHOR_FAMILIES`; `parseBundleId` guessed rather than parsed; a legacy id with a trailing digits segment mis-read as a minted hash.
